phase: ROADMAP Stage 5: blind evaluation packaging + reveal skeleton v1 (model/provider/version identity hidden from evaluator; synthetic fixtures only)
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only Stage 5 blind-evaluation skeleton. build_blind_evaluation_pack assigns each candidate a stable blind label (candidate_a, candidate_b, ...) and produces an evaluator-facing view exposing only blind id + case id + answer text, hiding provider/model/version; the identity mapping is kept in a separate reveal_map. validate_blind_evaluation_pack checks metadata presence, unique case ids, matching blind-id sets per case, and that no evaluator-facing candidate leaks an identity field. reveal_blind_evaluation_results joins reviewer scores (case id -> blind id -> score) back to the hidden identity and aggregates numeric scores into per-candidate means. A CLI tools/validate_blind_eval.py builds+validates and optionally reveals. Synthetic fixtures only; no real data, no model call, no network.
implemented: backend/server.py: added build_blind_evaluation_pack(suite, candidates) with method=blind_evaluation_pack_v1; evaluator_view exposes blind_ids + per-case candidates (blind_id, answer) only; identity kept in reveal_map; missing answers become empty strings so every case exposes the same blind ids.

backend/server.py: added validate_blind_evaluation_pack(pack) returning {passed, errors, warnings, case_count, blind_ids}; enforces metadata, unique case ids, per-case blind-id set equality, and no identity-field leak (provider/model/version/vendor/engine/system/family/name) on evaluator-facing candidates.

backend/server.py: added reveal_blind_evaluation_results(pack, scores_or_reviews) with method=blind_evaluation_reveal_v1; joins case-id->blind-id scores to reveal_map identity, aggregates numeric scores into per-candidate means, counts non-numeric reviews.
tools/validate_blind_eval.py: CLI (--suite/--candidates/--json, optional --reveal) delegating to the server helpers; exit 0/1/2.
tests/data/blind_eval_candidates_sample.json and tests/data/blind_eval_scores_sample.json: synthetic 2-candidate fixtures keyed to the benchmark sample's bench-001/002/003 case ids.
tests/test_blind_evaluation.py: 14 tests across packaging, validation, reveal, and the CLI.
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_blind_evaluation.py and tools/validate_blind_eval.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary; only the ROADMAP '模型和版本隐藏的盲评' item is marked done (other Stage 5 items untouched).
not_implemented: No real candidate/model output; fixtures are synthetic placeholder data.
No LLM/model invocation, scoring model, or automated reviewer.
Blind labels follow input order; positional de-anonymization protection (shuffling) is left to the upstream caller.
No human-vs-model comparison, adoption/edit-distance metrics, or regression-run automation (later Stage 5 items). No UI, persistence, or network call.

risks: Blind labels are assigned in candidate input order, so a caller that always lists a given provider first would leak identity positionally; the pack documents that upstream shuffling is required if that matters.

Identity-leak detection is a fixed field-name denylist (provider/model/version/vendor/engine/system/family/name); an identity embedded in free-text answers or an unusual field name would not be caught.
Reveal aggregates only values that parse as floats; non-numeric reviews are counted but not averaged, and there is no reviewer-agreement or significance analysis.
Fixtures are synthetic placeholder data and must not be mistaken for real model output.

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
credentials: No credentials or .env files were read, created, or modified.
No external network calls were used for implementation or local tests.
No push performed; commit/push left to the maintainer.
